sections.q: What is the function of the N/D pedal on the back of the Kirby?
sections.a: Tech drive -Neutral/Drive pedal makes it easier to push Kirby when the engine is running. Kirby drives in Drive when the engine is running, when the engine is off Kirby drives in Neutral.

sections.q: How do I know when the disposable bag is full and needs to be replaced?
sections.a: There is a fill line on the disposable bag. When the dirt reaches that line, you should replace the bag because it is no longer filtering properly. Use only genuine Kirby filter bags for proper cleaning.

sections.q: Is the outer canvas bag washable?
sections.a: Yes, it is recommended to wash it in a washing machine once a year on the Hand wash program.

sections.q: The vacuum cleaner is working, but why isn't it picking up dust from the floor?
Can I suck water with Kirby?
sections.a: No. Do not use Kirby to vacuum water from floors or carpets.

sections.q: How much carpet shampoo should I use in the system?
sections.a: Use only genuine Kirby shampoo. To measure the carpet shampoo, use the cap on the shampooer's reservoir. Fill the reservoir with warm (not boiling) water. For dosing, one cap of shampoo is required for the first line of the reservoir, two caps of shampoo for two lines of water, and three caps for three lines.

sections.q: Why isn't foam coming out of the system?
sections.a: For proper foam production, the suds screen and foam sponge must be in place in the tank. Check them before use.

sections.q: Why is the carpet too wet after shampooing?
sections.a: It could be because the filter or foam pad is not positioned correctly. Repeated cleaning of the same area can also cause excessive moisture. Recommended: allow the system to leave a layer of foam, then turn off the tank using the ON/OFF button before continuing to wash the carpet.

sections.q: The shampooer does not create foam and only dispenses water.
sections.a: Check that the strainer and foam sponge are in place, if they are missing or not properly installed the Kirby shampooer will not make or release foam. The strainer goes into the small hole in the tank, the hose goes over it, and the foam sponge goes into the large hole.

sections.q: How to remove the power head and put it back?
sections.a: To remove the powerhead, first make sure the unit is turned off. Press the Toe-Touch pedal all the way down. Then, lift the headlight cover, pull the strap lifter toward you and turn it counterclockwise until the red arrows align. Once the arrows align, turn the accessory lock counterclockwise, which will release the powerhead. You can now remove it and attach the next accessory and lower the cover. To reattach the powerhead, follow the steps above to remove the attached accessory. After that, the powerhead strap should be tightened on the hook from the inside. (If it is not, remove the strap lifter and turn it counterclockwise until the red arrows align. The hook should hook and stretch the strap from the inside.) Place the two hooks on the back of the the power head over the attachment bar on the front of the vacuum cleaner. Then push the power head towards the unit and turn the accessory lock to the right. Open the belt lift lever and turn it clockwise until the green arrows align. This will release the belt from the hook to rotate the brush roll. Or watch how to do all this on the video page..

sections.a: No, the warranty only applies to the rightful owner.

sections.q: Why won't the device turn on?
sections.a: First, make sure the appliance is plugged in, then make sure the accessory connected to the appliance is properly attached. Depending on the accessory you are using, make sure the power head, hose, carpet shampoo system, or air inlet guard are properly attached. Then, make sure the Mini Emtor-оt is properly attached. If they are all properly connected, your appliance should turn on. If it still does not turn on, take it to a service center.

sections.q: Does the belt smell like it's burning?
sections.a: It is likely that the belt is not rotating freely on the brush. Remove the belt lifter and turn it clockwise until the green arrows align. This will release the belt from the hook so that it can rotate freely on the brush. Also, check the brush for any tangled hairs or debris that may be preventing it from rotating (use a scalpel to remove them if necessary).

sections.q: The device does not turn on.
sections.a: There are two safety switches on your Kirby. One is on the front of the unit, and the other is under the plastic part where the bag attaches to the unit. If there is nothing attached to the front of the unit, such as a hose, power head, or shampoo system, the Kirby will not turn on. This is for safety reasons. If the mini emtor (the lower plastic part of the outer bag) or the shampoo tank or power head is not securely attached to the Kirby, the unit will not turn on. You will need to remove the bag or tank and reinsert it to make sure it is securely attached.
